title: io_uring fs operations can panic when runtime IO is disabled
author: fallintoplace
body_preview: ### Description  With `tokio_unstable`, the `io-uring` feature, and Linux fs support enabled, several `tokio::fs` APIs probe the runtime io_uring driver before falling back to the blocking filesystem path.
